facts.text: Ethereum ( ETH-USD ) opened at $2,418.43 on Thursday, October 15, 2026 , down 3.1% from Wednesday's opening price.
The price of ethereum moved down further this morning to $2,360.28 as of 7:25 a.m.
Here's a look at how the opening bitcoin price has changed versus last week, month, and year:
Bitcoin and ethereum prices opened in a very familiar pattern this morning.
Bitcoin has opened in the $83,000 or $81,000 range since last Friday.
Bitcoin, ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies are rapidly evolving.
Follow the latest developments from Yahoo Finance and others here .
For example, say you make a $500 purchase that earns 3% bitcoin rewards.
You'll earn $15 in U.S. dollars on that purchase.
With a bitcoin credit card, your $15 may be converted at the current bitcoin value (about 0.00014 bitcoin in October 2025) and deposited in your crypto account.
The biggest benefit of crypto rewards is the potential for growth over time.
By early October 2025, the value of those same rewards would have increased to about $114 — even if you didn't earn any additional rewards over that time.
The new Coinbase One Card, slated for fall 2025, will earn up to 4% bitcoin back and is exclusively available to Coinbase One subscription members.
Bitcoin's price has swung sharply in recent months.
Here's how to buy and store bitcoin as safely as possible.
Here's your beginner-friendly guide to the blockchain, smart contracts, DeFi, and how ETH differs from Bitcoin.

With those declines, Bitcoin has nearly erased all of its October gains, returning to a price last seen on October 1, while Ethereum and Solana both hit October lows on Friday per data from CoinGecko.
October got off to a hot start, but the historically strong month for Bitcoin and crypto prices—called "Uptober" by many investors—hit a roadblock Friday thanks to President Trump's trade war.
And now prices are falling fast as liquidations pile up.
The trend at first seemed poised to continue this year; the first week of this month, BTC surged some 10.5% to a new all-time high price north of $126,000 .
